title: Root state corruption: select_parent modifies rank before role check
description:
In dodag.rs select_parent(), lines 471-472 modify preferred_parent and rank BEFORE checking if set_role(Joined) succeeds at line 473. For a Root node that receives a DIO with rank < MIN_HOP_RANK_INCREASE (line 370 check passes since 255 < 256 is true), the parent passes admissible() at line 441-442 (which lacks the rank < MHRI check that candidate_admissible has), becomes best, and corrupts root state. In debug: panics at line 474 debug_assert. In release: silent corruption - root rank changes, preferred_parent set while role stays Root.

Fix: Add early return in select_parent() if role == Root, or add rank < MHRI check to admissible() method.
close_reason: Already implemented. The select_parent() function at /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/project-LICHEN/rust/lichen-rpl/src/dodag.rs has: (1) Early return for Root nodes at lines 593-595 preventing any mutation, (2) Save-and-rollback pattern at lines 636-648 that preserves previous_parent and previous_rank before mutation and restores them if set_role(Joined) fails, (3) Additional protection in process_dio() at lines 366-368 rejecting all DIOs for Root nodes, (4) Test coverage at lines 1406-1417 verifying root state is untouched by select_parent().
